title: balance_kbs Diversity Guard — Cross-Domain FPR vs. Shannon Entropy
description: Tests whether balance_kbs flag prevents large-KB dominance in cross-domain retrieval. Each query runs with balance_kbs=false and balance_kbs=true at top_k=10. Shannon entropy H = -sum(p_i * log2(p_i)) measures KB distribution diversity.

methodology.shannon_entropy_formula: H = -sum(p_i * log2(p_i)) where p_i = count_i / total_results

balance_kbs_false.note: Moderate diversity — AI-ML, Materials-ML, and Polymer KB each take 2 slots

balance_kbs_true.note: Maximum diversity achieved — 9 unique KBs, near-uniform across domains

balance_kbs_false.note: UNEXPECTED: balance_kbs=false already achieves max diversity for this query

balance_kbs_true.note: COUNTERPRODUCTIVE: balance_kbs reduces diversity! Polymer KB dominates 8/10 slots because 'energy storage dielectric capacitors' is a major sub-topic in that KB, causing it to outscore all other KBs within their balanced allocations

balance_kbs_false.note: UNEXPECTED: balance_kbs=false achieves max diversity; Transformer paper and related content scattered across KBs

balance_kbs_true.note: COUNTERPRODUCTIVE: AI-ML KB monopolizes 9/10 slots. When each KB gets fixed allocation slots, the KB with genuinely matching content (Transformer paper) wins every slot — balance_kbs amplifies the 'rich get richer' effect for queries with clear domain alignment

balance_kbs_false.note: Chemistry-Catalysis dominates 7/10 — classic large-bias problem balance_kbs was designed for

balance_kbs_true.note: SUCCESS: Maximum diversity achieved. balance_kbs breaks Chemistry-Catalysis monopoly completely

balance_kbs_false.note: Complete monopoly — all 10 results from the 73-doc polymer film KB. 0 entropy = zero diversity

balance_kbs_true.note: DRAMATIC SUCCESS: Entropy jumps from 0 to 3.12. balance_kbs breaks total monopoly, injecting 8 additional KBs and capping the dominant KB at just 1 result

summary.key_finding_1: balance_kbs is HIGHLY effective when a single KB dominates due to size (Q5: 0→3.12 entropy, Q4: 1.16→3.12). It breaks monopolies completely.
summary.key_finding_2: balance_kbs is COUNTERPRODUCTIVE when the query already returns diverse results. In Q2 and Q3, it REDUCED diversity by letting the most-relevant KB fill all its balanced slots, amplifying rather than reducing bias (Q3: 3.12→0.47 entropy).
summary.key_finding_3: The root cause: balance_kbs caps per-KB result counts but does NOT penalize internal relevance scores. When each KB gets N slots and one KB has 10x more relevant chunks than any other, it wins all N of its slots with top-scoring content.
summary.recommendation: balance_kbs should include a per-KB score-normalization step before slot allocation, or apply a penalty proportional to KB size. A hybrid approach: use balance_kbs for KBs with >N docs (large-KB guard) but fall back to unconstrained retrieval for queries whose unconstrained results are already diverse (entropy > threshold).
